description: Fetch Sunday or daily lectionary readings. Pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a single day, omit date for today in tz, or pass startDate and endDate for a range. Shared params: tradition, tz. Use this when the user wants scripture citations or Daily Office readings. Do not use it to list seasons, look up a feast by name, or get the cycle letter — use get_calendar or search_lectionary.

date.description: Single civil date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to get today in tz. Do not combine with startDate/endDate.

endDate.description: End of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Requires startDate.

startDate.description: Start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Requires endDate.

tradition.description: Lectionary tradition. rcl (default) is the Revised Common Lectionary; catholic is the Roman Catholic lectionary; episcopal is RCL Sundays with BCP Daily Office weekdays; bcp is the BCP Daily Office only.

tz.description: IANA time zone used to decide "today" and the current civil year, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London. Defaults to America/New_York (or LECTIO_TIMEZONE). Takes effect once the API tz parameter is deployed.

name: get_readings
title: Get lectionary readings
